scientific_question: Is the +0.08074 fixed-CE gap of the four-bit pair-coded full MLP caused primarily by c_fc coding or by the residual-writing c_proj coding?

causal_basis.finding: The exact pair code passes output and input-JVP gates but leaves +0.08074 fixed CE. A second pair-code stage approximately squares residual distortion but must only be assigned to a causally dominant matrix side.
causal_basis.not_a_new_representation: The diagnostic reuses the exact immutable codebooks and codes from the failed pair-VQ gate. It performs no fitting, optimization, code selection, or language-model update.

variants: pair-coded c_fc and c_proj consistency replay

frozen_decision_rule.dominant_side: A side is dominant only if its side-only CE gap is at least 1.5 times the other side-only gap and at least 60% of the measured both-side gap.
frozen_decision_rule.if_c_fc_dominates: Preregister one two-stage residual pair code for c_fc only; leave c_proj at one stage.
frozen_decision_rule.if_c_proj_dominates: Preregister one two-stage residual pair code for c_proj only; leave c_fc at one stage.
frozen_decision_rule.if_neither_dominates: Reject asymmetric bit allocation. Do not guess a side or launch training; reconcile interaction terms before another representation.
frozen_decision_rule.consistency_gate: The replayed both-side gap must agree with +0.08074283599853516 within 0.002 and the dense control must agree with 3.674412250518799 within 0.002.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run only this zero-update side-localization diagnostic on PRO6.
not_allowed: rate, bit-width, vector-length, seed, or optimizer sweeps
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll because the fixed-evaluation runtime is expected to remain below five minutes.
